text:
maria: heads up — QA flagged that a bunch of requests are being attributed to the wrong cost center in the Console after the TS/Go SDKs shipped 2.3.0 :grimacing:
aditya: hmm that's not great. what header are the SDKs setting?
kevin: they added `x-rw-cost-center` as a convenience metadata header (for apps to annotate requests). meant to be metadata only, not a billing key.
maria: example we saw in logs: `x-rw-cost-center: acct-sales-eu` ; curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "x-rw-cost-center: acct-sales-eu" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generation`
june: but Console is grouping usage by cost centers for dashboards and quotas, right? so it's reading that header and mapping it to billing tag? :thinking_face:
aditya: yep looks like a mapping rule in the analytics pipeline started treating any `x-rw-*` header with `cost` substring as an attribution tag. accidental regex.
kevin: oof. that's on us in the pipeline change last week. the intent was to pick explicit `x-rw-billing-tag` only.
maria: client teams are seeing spikes in the wrong buckets — some teams could be over their quota because of this. Can we short-circuit?
kevin: short term: I can patch the mapping rule to ignore `x-rw-cost-center` and restart the ingestion consumer. will do a canary in `platform-canary` first.
deploy-bot: deploy started by kevin to platform-canary at 2026-03-20T15:12:02Z :rocket:
aditya: longer term we should: 1) deprecate `x-rw-cost-center` as an attribution input, 2) introduce `x-rw-billing-tag` as explicit billing header, 3) bump SDKs to opt into the new header, and 4) make Console show both `metadata` and `billing` fields in rollout UI.
june: agree. also need migration notes for customers and a console alert if we detect `x-rw-cost-center` used for billing. UX owners: can we show a warning on dashboards?
maria: I'll open the docs PR and draft the customer email.
kevin: patching mapping now, will post canary link + ingestion metrics in 10m. if canary looks good I'll promote to prod.
aditya: once mapping is fixed we'll coordinate SDK minor release that renames the header usage and adds opt-in for the billing header. keep the metadata pass-through allowed but not mapped for billing.
maria: thanks — appreciate the quick response :heart:
kevin: no problem. follow-ups: ops ticket + changelog entry + console warning card.
